latex.title: Treatment X elevates marker expression
latex.author: Example Author
latex.abstract: Treatment X elevates marker expression over time in a controlled cohort (example).

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.label: sec:intro
sections.body: Marker expression is a key readout. Treatment X increased expression 4.5-fold at Day14 \cite{ref1}. Prior work reported similar dynamics \cite{ref2}.

sections.heading: Methods
sections.label: sec:methods
sections.body: Two arms, n=6 per timepoint; expression measured at Day3, Day7, Day14; reported as mean $\pm$ SD.

sections.heading: Results
sections.label: sec:results
sections.body: Treatment rose to 4.5 by Day14 versus control 0.9.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.label: sec:conclusion
sections.body: The increase is time-dependent in this cohort; mechanism remains open (Section~\ref{sec:results}).

claims.text: Treatment X increased expression 4.5-fold at Day14.
